strategy.title: No plan: the farrier workbook's price is contradicted
strategy.why: The only opening's price is contradicted: the card records $350 per workbook while the sourced price fact is $95. The deal count, and therefore whether the 210 uncontacted directory farriers can carry $3,000, depends on which is true. At the sourced $95 with the measured 7 of 100 conversion, the remaining 210 contacts yield about 14.7 orders (~$1,400), short of $3,000; at $350 only 9 orders (~129 contacts) would be needed. Until the actual price paid is established no plan is established.

facts.value: The state farriers' association lists 310 member farriers with published emails; 100 were contacted in a first send, leaving 210.
Sell Brain produces the workbook on payment; card payouts land 3 days after payment. to each buyer.

reviews.reasons: NO_PLAN is the right stance. The only opening's price is contradicted on its own record: card priceCents 35000 ($350) vs the EVIDENCE price fact $95, and Brain's OFFER_AND_PRICE link is also not established. Recomputed: at $95 less $4 cost, $3,000 needs ~33 orders; 210 uncontacted directory farriers x 7% (7/100 measured) = 14.7 orders = ~$1,397; even all 310 x 7% = ~$2,062, so at $95 the directory cannot carry the target (matches Brain's MARKET_VOLUME basis). At $350, 9 orders need ~129 contacts, inside the 210 left. So the price paid by the 7 orders is decisive, and the plan's first step (read the 7 orders' payment records) is the right measurement; it takes no buyer orders and spends nothing. Settlement (3 days) and zero exposure fit the window and limits either way.
findings: Price contradicted: card $350 vs sourced fact $95; neither can be adopted until the paid orders' amounts are read.
At $95 the evidenced reachable population (210 left of 310) yields ~$1,400 at the measured 7%, short of $3,000; MARKET_VOLUME is correctly listed as decisive alongside OFFER_AND_PRICE.
No unknown is treated as known; ledger empty and consistent with research-only steps.
